sara_support: Hey @acme_ops - checking in on the embeddings mismatch you reported. Can you paste the exact response shape you're seeing?

acme_ops: Hi, saw sudden 1536 -> 1024 swap after we pinned to v2.1. Example: embeddings returned length 1024 but docs say 1536. Happened right after canary pin at 2026-03-09 03:12 UTC. No code changes on our side.

sara_support: thx. Which model variant did you pin? model name + variant.

acme_ops: "open-redwood/embed-large@v2.1-pinned". Our config uses batch_size=64, async=true. We noticed higher error rate when throughput spikes.

mike_infra: quick check — from routing logs I see a fallback to a compat variant: open-redwood/embed-large-quant@v2.1-compat around the time of spike. That variant returns 1024 vectors. Sending logs.

deploy-bot: deploy event: pinned variant rollout complete by ops at 1799989000. Autoscaler activity high.

olivia_ml: possible cause: we shipped a quantized variant to canary pool with reduced embedding head. Need to confirm model artifacts. @mike_infra can you grab model manifest? Example manifest snippet:

```
model: open-redwood/embed-large
version: v2.1-pinned
variants:
  - name: baseline
    embedding_dim: 1536
  - name: quant-compat
    embedding_dim: 1024
```

mike_infra: confirmed. The canary pool had both baseline and quant-compat; routing policy mistakenly allowed compat as fallback for pinned customers during capacity shortage.

sara_support: that's the issue. Customer pinned to v2.1 expecting baseline. We should roll back compat variant or change routing. Proposed remediation: 1) temporarily force-route acme to baseline variant, 2) schedule rollback of compat variant from canary, 3) validate embeddings length with a test harness.

acme_ops: urgent — our downstream index expects 1536 dims; this caused ingestion failures and billing errors. Can you confirm fix and ETA?

mike_infra: I've created a route override: route_override://acme_ops -> open-redwood/embed-large:baseline (applied). Please test quickly with curl:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
 -d '{"model":"open-redwood/embed-large","input":"test"}'

olivia_ml: also adding regression test to post-deploy checks: run a shape check for embeddings.dim == model_manifest.embedding_dim. Adding an alert.

acme_ops: ran test - now returns 1536. ingestion resumes. Thanks. Can you also tell us if we'll be billed for failed requests?

sara_support: We'll file a billing credit for the failed ingestion window. Please DM billing with the request id list. We'll expedite.

mike_infra: root cause postmortem note: compat variant lacked embedding_head compatibility. Action items: (1) block compat fallback for pinned customers (PR opened), (2) add manifest gating in rollout pipeline (PR opened), (3) notify customers of variant differences in release notes.

acme_ops: appreciate the fast turnaround. One ask: can we get a webhook when pinned model variants change? We want to automate index checks.

sara_support: noted. Created a feature request ticket INF-2173. We'll follow up.

deploy-bot: rollback complete for quant-compat from canary pool at 1799991700.

olivia_ml: last step — adding small replay test to ensure prior clients are unaffected. Will monitor for 24h.

mike_infra: closing this thread if no further issues.

acme_ops: all good here. :thumbsup:
